:::{#def-joint-entropy}
#### Joint entropy

Let $X$ and $Y$ be [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) with [joint probability mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-joint-pmf)
$p(x, y) \eqdef \P(X=x, Y=y)$.
Their **joint entropy** is the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of the pair $(X, Y)$:

$$H(X, Y) \eqdef \E{-\log p(X, Y)}.$$

:::
